# Vendored scripts

Self-hosted copies of the libraries the site loads, so pages do not depend on a third-party CDN.

| File | Library | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gsap.min.js`, `ScrollTrigger.min.js` | GSAP | 3.12.5 | GreenSock standard license (https://gsap.com/standard-license) |
| `anime.umd.min.js` | Anime.js | 4.5.0 | MIT |
| `emailjs.min.js` | @emailjs/browser | 4.x (as served by jsDelivr on 2026-10-29) | MIT |

Fonts (Cormorant Garamond, DM Sans) are self-hosted in `assets/fonts/` (latin subset, SIL Open Font License 1.1) and declared in `assets/css/fonts.css`.
